tools.name: canada_building_permits
tools.description: Search issued building permits from 19 Canadian cities' official open data (including Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Halifax, Mississauga, Kitchener, Waterloo, Victoria and Surrey), with optional Calgary/Edmonton planning and business-licence signals, federal contract awards and CanadaBuys open tenders. Filter by city or province, issue-date range, project value, permit type, work type, status and keyword. Use it to find construction leads, contractor and supplier prospects, or local development activity in Canada. Returns one clean JSON row per permit. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/canada-building-permits on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.003 per permit row, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/canada-building-permits

cities.description: Cities. Cities to query for building_permits when province is omitted. Setting province overrides this selection, including prefilled defaults. Opt-in calgary_* / edmonton_* sources are scoped by source selection: choosing them runs that feed even if this list omits the city, and does not add that city's building permits unless building_permits is also selected.

dateFrom.description: Issued from (YYYY-MM-DD). Only permits issued on or after this date. Leave empty for no lower limit. Delta publishes no issue date, so for Delta this filters on the completion date (the log warns). Opt-in sources use their event_date; federal data is first filtered to federalFiscalYears and then this bound is applied locally within its scan cap.

dateTo.description: Issued to (YYYY-MM-DD). Only permits issued on or before this date. For Delta this filters on the completion date.

minValue.description: Minimum project value (CAD). Only permits with an estimated construction value at or above this. Permits with no value recorded (blank or 0) are left out when you set a value filter. Delta and Winnipeg publish no value, so they are skipped when you set this.

maxValue.description: Maximum project value (CAD). Only permits with an estimated construction value at or below this. Permits with no value recorded (blank or 0) are left out. Delta and Winnipeg publish no value, so they are skipped when you set this.

permitType.description: Permit type contains. Text match (contains, not case-sensitive) on the city's permit type. The words differ by city: see the README table. 'Residential' matches nothing in Oakville, Burlington, Kingston, Victoria, Surrey and Edmonton.

workType.description: Work type contains. Text match on work type, e.g. New, Addition, Alteration. Halifax accepts exactly: New Building, Addition, Renovation. Kingston, Victoria and Delta have no work-type column and are skipped when you set this.

status.description: Status contains. Text match on permit status, e.g. Issued, Closed. Surrey and Edmonton have no status column and are skipped when you set this.

keyword.description: Keyword. Searches each city's permit number and type/description-like fields.

maxItems.description: Max permits in total. Total permits across all cities (default 100, up to 50,000). Split evenly between the cities you pick; a city that has fewer matches passes its unused share on to the next cities. In opt-in source mode this caps all saved signal rows, including permits, with a fair share per city/source task.

maxItemsPerCity.description: Max permits per city (optional). Optional upper limit for each city, newest first. A city never gets more than this or its share of 'Max permits in total', whichever is smaller. In opt-in source mode, all source types in a city share this cap; national contracts have no inferred city.

province.description: Province (optional). Query every covered municipality in this province. Overrides cities, including prefilled city defaults. Coverage is limited to the municipalities listed in the README.

includeAddresses.description: Include project site addresses. When false, project_address is null for every row. Addresses are only available from reviewed, enabled sources; see city provenance.

sources.description: Sources (0.3 beta, opt-in). Opt-in source list. Prefill is building_permits for the Console form; there is no schema default, so cloud runs that omit sources keep permits-only unless signals is set. When signals is set and sources is omitted (or only the building_permits prefill), every compatible enabled feed for those signal types is selected — including held diagnostics. Explicit extra sources enable 0.3 signal mode. Selecting calgary_* or edmonton_* runs that city feed even if cities omits the city; it does not auto-add that city's building permits. Nine enabled extra sources, including H…

federalFiscalYears.description: Federal reporting fiscal years (optional). Federal contracts only. Omit for the current Canadian fiscal year (April–March), e.g. 2026-2027. Optionally select 1–3 consecutive-year labels such as ["2026-2027", "2025-2026"]. These filter reporting periods, not award dates; declared contracts C only. Results sort by contract_date descending WITHIN the hard scan cap (100 raw rows, 50/page, Crawl-delay 20s), not globally newest. dateFrom/dateTo/keyword/minValue/maxValue further filter event dates locally inside that cap; no automatic fallback to historical fiscal years. CKAN full-text q is unavaila…

signals.description: Signal types (opt-in). Optional nonempty type filter. Supplying this opts into common lead records, even for permits. With explicit sources (beyond the building_permits prefill alone), uses their intersection; without sources, selects every compatible feed (held feeds return diagnostics). Default permits-only output stays unchanged when signals is omitted and no extra sources are selected. tender_open selects canadabuys_open_tenders (federal open notices only; no provincial tenders). award selects ns_tender_awards (NS historical awarded public tenders); contract_award retains the existing fed…

closingAfter.description: Tender closes after (YYYY-MM-DD). Strict YYYY-MM-DD lower bound for open-tender closing_date. Default when omitted: today in America/Halifax. Only future calendar days match — same-day deadlines are excluded even if the clock is still before the hour. Applies only to tender_open / canadabuys_open_tenders rows.

refreshCanadaBuysCache.description: Refresh CanadaBuys tender cache. When true, force a fresh download of the CanadaBuys open-tenders CSV and overwrite today's entry in the named KV store cbp-canadabuys-cache (America/Halifax date key). Default false uses the daily cache when present. Useful for measuring cache-miss cost.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).

tools.name: loblaws_grocery_prices
tools.description: Search grocery products by keyword across the 14 Loblaw banners (Loblaws, No Frills, Real Canadian Superstore, Maxi, Zehrs and others) at a chosen store, postal code or city. Returns price, sale and unit price, deals, PC Optimum points when offered, and stock. Use it for Canadian grocery price comparison, meal-cost estimates or deal tracking. 'keywords' is required. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/loblaws-grocery-prices on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.0005 per product, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/loblaws-grocery-prices

keywords.description: Search terms. Products to search for, e.g. milk, eggs, bread. Example: ["milk","eggs"]

banner.description: Store banner. Which Loblaw chain to search.

storeId.description: Store number. 4-digit store number (shown in the store page URL on the banner website). Prices and stock are for this store. Leave empty to use Postal code or City.

postalCode.description: Postal code. Used when Store number is empty: picks the store of this banner whose postal code matches yours most closely (same first letters). Not a distance search.

city.description: City. Used when Store number and Postal code are empty: picks a store of this banner in this city.

language.description: Language. Language of names and descriptions.

maxItems.description: Max products. Total products to save across all search terms (split evenly).

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Max products per search term. Optional fixed limit per search term. 0 = split Max products evenly.

fetchAll.description: Fetch all results. Ignore Max products and save everything (up to 50,000).

skipSponsored.description: Skip sponsored products. Leave out products marked Sponsored (not charged).

runOptions.description: Optional run limits (not passed to the Actor). maxTotalChargeUsd caps what this single call can cost you on Apify.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).

timeoutSecs.description: Run timeout in seconds (Apify's synchronous limit is 300).

tools.name: canada_federal_corporations
tools.description: Search federally incorporated Canadian corporations from the official Corporations Canada dataset on open.canada.ca (updated daily): corporation number, business number, names, governing act, status, incorporation date, last annual filing, city and province. Filter by province, active/inactive status, incorporation date range or name keyword. Use it for KYC-style lookups, new-company lead lists or market sizing. Street addresses are removed. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/canada-federal-corporations on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.003 per corporation, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/canada-federal-corporations

statusGroup.description: Active or inactive. Which source files to read.

includeNonCbca.description: Include non-CBCA corporations. Also include not-for-profits, boards of trade, co-operatives etc. (default: only Canada Business Corporations Act companies).

province.description: Province/territory. Province of the registered office.

status.description: Status contains. Case-insensitive match on status or status detail, e.g. 'Dissolved', 'Amalgamated', 'Dissolution Pending'.

incorporatedFrom.description: Incorporated on/after (YYYY-MM-DD). Based on the anniversary (incorporation/amalgamation) date.

nameKeyword.description: Name contains. Case-insensitive match on the English or French corporate name.

maxItems.description: Max corporations. Stop after this many matches (default 100, maximum 50,000).

fetchAll.description: Fetch all matches (up to 50,000). Ignore Max corporations and return every match, capped at 50,000 per run. Use filters to stay under the cap.

flagIndividuals.description: Flag names that may be individuals. Adds nameMayBeIndividual (true/false). True for professional corporations ('.. Professional Corporation', 'Dr. ..', '.. MD Inc.', '.. Personal Real Estate Corporation') and names that start with (or, in French names, follow 'Gestion', 'Les Entreprises' etc. with) a given name and a surname, e.g. 'John Smith Holdings Inc.', 'Paige Thompson Photography Inc.'. Heuristic only.

redactIndividuals.description: Blank names that may be individuals. On by default. Replaces flagged corporate names (name and nameAlt) with '[redacted: may be an individual]' (about 2.7% of active corporations). The corporation number, business number and url are kept, so you can still look the record up. Turn off to get every name.

tools.name: canada_business_funding_finder
tools.description: Find Canadian small-business funding programs (federal, Atlantic Canada, Nova Scotia and youth programs) from a curated, source-verified dataset: grants, loans and support programs with amounts, deadlines, eligibility age range and sectors. Filter by province, program type, sector, intake status, deadline range, applicant age and keyword. Use it when a founder or agent asks 'what funding can my Canadian business get?'. Bundled data, no live scraping. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/canada-business-funding-finder on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.01 per program result, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/canada-business-funding-finder

provinces.description: Provinces. 2-letter codes, e.g. ["NS"]. Keeps national programs, Atlantic programs (for NS/NB/PE/NL) and Nova Scotia programs (for NS). Empty = all.

packages.description: Packages. Any of federal, atlantic-ns, young-founder. Empty = all.

types.description: Types. grant, loan, rebate, tax credit, support. Empty = all.

sectors.description: Sectors. Sector tags, e.g. ai, technology, export. Empty = all.

intakeStatus.description: Intake status. ongoing, seasonal, closed, unknown. Empty = all.

minVerificationLevel.description: Minimum verification level. partial (default) hides unverified records. unverified = include all (unverified records are not charged).

amountStatus.description: Amount status. published, no_published_cap, not_found. Empty = all.

ageMin.description: Applicant age from. Drops programs whose confirmed age range ends below this. Programs with no stated range stay.

ageMax.description: Applicant age to. Drops programs whose confirmed age range starts above this.

deadlineFrom.description: Deadline from. YYYY-MM-DD. When a deadline range is set, only programs with a dated deadline in range are kept (see includeUndatedDeadlines).

includeUndatedDeadlines.description: Keep programs with no dated deadline. Only used with a deadline range.

query.description: Keyword. All words must appear in name, agency, summary, tip or sectors.

maxItems.description: Max items. Default 50. Hard cap 50,000. Each verified/partial record costs $0.01.

fetchAll.description: Fetch all. Opt-in: return every matching record (up to the 50,000 cap), ignoring maxItems.

includeTermsPendingSources.description: Include terms-pending sources. Off by default. Adds NGen, Scale AI, Futurpreneur, Ulnooweg, Volta, BDC and Canada Media Fund records, whose terms are restrictive or not yet reviewed.

runOptions.description: Optional run limits (not passed to the Actor). maxTotalChargeUsd caps what this single call can cost you on Apify.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).
